$comment: Advisories that the Security Audit gate tolerates, with a reason and an expiry.
Every entry MUST justify why it is not exploitable here and MUST carry an expires date.
The gate fails when an entry expires, and warns when an entry no longer matches any
advisory, so stale suppressions cannot accumulate silently.

allow.reason: Reached only through @puppeteer/browsers' browser-download path (install/extract of a Chrome zip). This package ships puppeteer-core and resolves Chrome via `channel`/`executablePath` or attaches with `connect()`, so no archive is ever downloaded or extracted at runtime. extract-zip has no patched release; upstream fixed it by dropping the dependency in @puppeteer/browsers 3.x, which requires puppeteer-core v25 (semver-major).
Same root cause and same unreachable code path as GHSA-jmr9-qjv8-65gv. Cleared by the puppeteer-core v25 upgrade.
